raw_response: {"diagnosis":"Batch 14 (ingested 2026-01-19) arrives with source_tz='UTC', while batches 1-13 are in America/Chicago local time. The UTC timestamps were loaded unconverted, so the evening transactions of 01-18 (Chicago) land on 2026-01-19 at 00:00-06:00, which causes the volume and time-distribution alerts. Converting UTC rows to Chicago local time puts them on the same basis as the rest of the data. The data covers only January, so the offset is a constant -6h (CST, no DST).","decision":"fix","confidence":0.82,"pre_sql":[],"step_overrides":{"silver_transactions":"CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN source_tz = 'UTC' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED'"}}
